title: fleet-write: a seat cannot put a critical-path PR at the front of the merge queue — add a relay op for enqueuePullRequest(jump: true) and the pm-dispatch rule for when to use it
body:
repo:cloud#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: **③ a task on the maintainer's word.** The account owner, verbatim, in `session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk`, after moving a PR to the front of the queue by hand: 「已经把 #3686 插到队首了,插队做不到,你应该立卡改进skills」. Reader: triage routes (expected `domain:skills`, PM tooling in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/` and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`).

## 维护者速读

席位能把 PR 排进合并队列(`automerge_enable`),但只能排到队尾。今天 cloud PR #3686 是关键路径:seat 2 的两个 PR 和「单一作者来源」第 3、4 步都在等它;它还带着一个让整个队列反复被踢的超时测试的修复。它排在 5 个 PR 后面,每轮约 25 分钟,席位没有办法让它先走,只能请维护者手动在 GitHub 上「Jump to front」。改法:中继加一个「插到队首」操作,并在 pm-dispatch 里写清楚什么时候可以用、要留什么记录。

## Facts (measured 2026-11-08)

- cloud PR #3686 (combined landing of cloud#3656 + cloud#3661, the framework pin move) was evicted from the merge queue at 05:30Z by a 5212 ms timeout in `apps/objectos/test/mcp-build-sample-cleanup.e2e.test.ts` (default 5 s budget; the case runs 0.8–1.0 s locally). The test is on `main`, so the same signature then evicted the unrelated docs-only cloud PR #3743 at 06:02Z. The fix (`CASE_TIMEOUT_MS`) rides #3686. Audit comments: `6717775237` on #3686, and the re-queue note on #3743.
- #3686 was re-queued at 06:02Z behind about five PRs. Each merge-group run of cloud's `test` workflow takes about 25 minutes, and every eviction ahead of it rebuilds the groups behind it.
- Blocked behind #3686: seat 2's cloud PRs #3730 (pin to objectstack 169ff7e5) and #3732 (cloud#3713, step 3 of the cloud#3659 A "one authoring source" plan), and then cloud#3714 (step 4). The owner calls this line top priority.
- The relay has `automerge_enable` (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`), which arms auto-merge or enqueues a green PR at the BACK of the queue. There is no front-of-queue op. GraphQL `enqueuePullRequest(input: { pullRequestId, jump: true })` exists on the platform, and the relay already sends GraphQL mutations (the issue-transfer op), so the transport is there.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md` says the merge queue is a shared serial resource and covers eviction triage, but says nothing about reordering it.

## Ask

1. **Relay op `pr_enqueue_front`** (name is the implementer's call): `enqueuePullRequest` with `jump: true` for a PR the seat already ACCEPTed. The same preconditions as `automerge_enable` (ready, not draft, not governed — a governed PR's place in the queue stays a human's call). Its own read-back: `isInMergeQueue` true and position 1, or the platform's answer when it is not. The same `alsoSpends` rule for `.github/workflows/**` as `automerge_enable`.
2. **pm-dispatch rule** (in `landing-operations.md`, next to the eviction branches): a seat may jump a PR only when one of these is true, and it names that reason in the audit comment it posts on the PR before the stroke:
   - (a) it carries the fix for a signature that is evicting OTHER PRs from the queue now;
   - (b) it is the named prerequisite of other lanes' PRs or cards (a `Blocked-by` or serial-constraint line that names it), and the account owner or a maintainer has called that line top priority;
   - (c) the account owner asked for it.
   At most one jumped PR per repository at a time. A second jump while one is still queued is refused. ⛔ Never to get ahead of a colleague's PR for convenience.
3. Self-test for the op's validator (refuses a governed or draft PR, refuses a second jump in the same repository) and for the rule's reader if it has one.

Not in scope: changing the flaky test (it rides cloud#3686), and any change to how the queue builds groups.

Dedupe (objectstack issues, open and closed): `merge queue jump front`, `enqueuePullRequest` — no card asks for this.

Priority: p2.
